title: The Ladoga's Observation Bay
caption: Day three adrift by a dead star. The oxygen is running out. Someone is knocking on the glass from outside.

captions.text: For three days the Ladoga has been drifting by a dead star. No contact.
Gordeev went outside on Tuesday. The tether was reeled in empty.
LIDA counts the crew again. Three out of three on board.
